t: The $(item)Pneumatic Jackhammer/$ is a highly versatile mining tool, which can break all types of block equally effectively, using $(l:base_concepts/pressure)pressure/$ to do so. Its mining speed and air capacity can be upgraded in a $(l:machines/charging_station)Charging Station/$ with $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)Speed Upgrades/$ and $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#volume)Volume Upgrades/$, respectively.

$(item)气动凿岩锤/$是一种用途极其广泛的采矿工具，能够借助$(l:base_concepts/pressure)气压/$高效地破坏所有类型的方块。它的挖掘速度和储气容量分别可以在$(l:machines/charging_station)充气站/$中使用$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)速度升级/$和$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#volume)容量升级/$进行提升。

A newly-crafted Jackhammer comes without a $(thing)Drill Bit/$, so isn't very useful. You will need to insert one; right-click the Jackhammer to open its configuration GUI, and place a bit in the top-right slot.$(p)There are four types of Drill Bit, in ascending power and cost:$(li)Iron/$$(li)Compressed Iron/$$(li)Diamond/$$(li)Netherite/$
新制作出的手提钻默认不带有$(thing)钻孔头/$，因此几乎派不上用场。你需要先装入一个；右键点击手提钻以打开其配置 GUI，然后将钻孔头放入右上角的槽位。$(p)钻孔头共有四种类型，按性能和成本从低到高依次为：$(li)铁/$$(li)压缩铁/$$(li)钻石/$$(li)下界合金/$

The Jackhammer supports several dig modes, including some $(thing)veinminer/$ functionality, making it very easy to dig out large areas quickly. The dig modes supported depend on the $(thing)Drill Bit/$ you're using; better bits support more dig modes (in addition to improved dig speed).$(p)To set a dig mode, open the Jackhammer GUI (right-click) and use the button in the lower right (see opposite).
手提钻支持多种挖掘模式，其中还包括一些$(thing)矿脉挖掘/$功能，让你能够非常轻松地快速挖出大范围区域。支持哪些挖掘模式取决于你使用的$(thing)钻孔头/$；更好的钻孔头支持更多挖掘模式（此外还会提升挖掘速度）。$(p)要设置挖掘模式，请打开手提钻的 GUI（右键），然后使用右下角的按钮（见对页）。
$(italic)Jackhammer GUI with a Netherite Drill Bit installed and 3x3 dig mode selected/$
$(italic)已安装下界合金钻头并选中 3x3 挖掘模式的风镐界面/$

The Jackhammer cannot be enchanted normally in an $(thing)Enchanting Table/$, but it is possible to insert a $(thing)Silk Touch/$ or $(thing)Fortune/$ enchanted book, via the GUI. A book placed in the book slot (top center) will bestow its enchantment on the Jackhammer.
手提钻无法像平常那样在$(thing)附魔台/$中附魔，但你可以通过 GUI 插入一本带有$(thing)精准采集/$或$(thing)时运/$的附魔书。将书放入书槽（顶部中央）后，其附魔就会赋予手提钻。

This has the advantage of being easily swappable between a Silk Touch and a Fortune book, as you need.$(p)If you're finding it difficult to obtain the books you need (vanilla book enchanting being so very random), bear in mind that the $(l:manufacturing/pressure_chamber)Pressure Chamber/$ is able to strip enchantments from tools and place them on books.
这样做的好处是，你可以根据需要，轻松在精准采集附魔书和时运附魔书之间切换。$(p)如果你发现很难获得自己需要的附魔书（毕竟原版附魔书附魔实在太随机了），请记住，$(l:manufacturing/pressure_chamber)压力室/$可以从工具上剥离附魔并将其转移到书上。
